# Signal Loom active snapshot
Date: 12 February 2026

## Current intention
The current aim is to explore how sustained pressure can shape a slow visual ribbon in a small indoor installation.

## Current direction
The installation now uses a pressure pad and a fabric diffuser. The rotary dial and glass screen are earlier, replaced choices.

## Remaining issue
Pressure readings still drift during a long hold. This remains unresolved and needs a calibration check.

## Confirmed next action
The next agreed task is to run a ten-minute pressure-hold calibration on 13 February and record the drift. This task is pending at this snapshot.
